privacy.title: Data and privacy
privacy.intro: Squabble stores data in this installation. The project does not operate a hosted account service or collect telemetry.
privacy.stored: Your account, holdings, research, paper trades and settings are stored in this installation's PostgreSQL database. Passwords and recovery codes are stored as hashes. Saved model and market-data keys are encrypted; notification settings may contain readable credentials in the database.
privacy.outbound: Quotes, exchange rates and some public research data use external sources. If you configure a model, OCR, a local agent or a notification channel, Squabble sends the relevant request to the endpoint you chose. Those providers have their own data policies and may charge you.
privacy.browser: This browser or desktop webview stores login tokens and any OCR provider key in local storage. The OCR key is not encrypted and remains after sign-out until that storage is cleared. Keep your recovery code private. For backups, quit the desktop app before copying its data directory, or back up both Docker volumes together.

screenshotFlow.intro: Upload a broker holdings screenshot, choose how to recognize it, then review before importing.
screenshotFlow.noAgentHint: No idle connected agent supports image attachments. Use a vision API or connect an agent in Settings.
screenshotFlow.modelVisionNotice: Image attachment support does not guarantee model vision support. Ensure the default or selected model can read images. A failure will not switch models or APIs automatically.
screenshotFlow.modelInvalid: This model configuration is not supported by the agent. Use its default or check the model name.
screenshotFlow.keyMemoryOnly: Kept in this page's memory only
screenshotFlow.localPrivacy: Extract sends the screenshot to the selected agent, which may send it to its model provider using the signed-in account. Processing may occur off-device and consume account usage. This app handles screenshots temporarily and does not automatically retry extraction.
screenshotFlow.apiPrivacy: Extract sends the screenshot through the app backend to the configured vision API and may incur charges. The API key is used only in this page and the request. The app does not persist the screenshot or key, and failures are not retried automatically.
screenshotFlow.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 8 MiB.
screenshotFlow.done: Extraction complete. Review the results below.
screenshotFlow.prepareNewAttempt: Dismiss this task and prepare a new extraction
screenshotFlow.reviewHint: Check every ticker, name, share count and per-share cost. A blank cost means unknown, not zero; do not substitute current price or profit/loss. Detected currency is a reference only: the imported currency follows the ticker's market. Check market suffixes such as .HK, .SH and .SZ.
screenshotFlow.invalidRows: Enter a ticker and positive shares. Cost must be non-negative or blank.
screenshotFlow.reviewAcknowledgement: I have reviewed and corrected these holdings and confirm they are ready to import.
